english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for sending a letter or parcel through the post.
This is the all-purpose everyday verb for sending a parcel to someone, usually by post or courier.
Use 寄 when sending a letter, parcel, or other item through the post or a delivery service.
Use this for sending a letter or parcel through the postal service.

examples.english: I’ll mail a document to you tomorrow.

examples.english: I’ll ship the parcel to you tomorrow.

examples.english: I’ll send you a letter tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 gei3 fung1 seon3 bei2 nei5

examples.english: I’ll post a letter to you tomorrow.
